content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
I found the red ball. The robot is now resting close to it and facing it: the ball is in the middle of the bottom camera image, about 20–30 cm in front of its feet.

**How I found it:**
1. The ball wasn't visible from the starting spot. A large black case was blocking part of the view. The only red thing I saw on the floor was a red lid on a container by the wall, not the ball.
2. I walked forward past the case to the right and looked around again, but still didn't see it.
3. I walked into the open area toward the door and looked around once more. This time I saw the ball on the floor about 1 m away, to the left, near a desk with an office chair.
4. I turned toward it, walked over, and made a small correction to stop right in front of it.

The robot said "I found the red ball" and is now crouched with its motors off. It never fell.
